versions.content: function Bind [SWS_CORE_00870] Upstream: RS_AP_00130 template <typename F> auto Bind (F &&f) const -> <see below>; Call the given Callable, and return a new Result with the result of the call. The Callable is expected to be compatible to one of these two interfaces: • Result<XXX, E> f(); • XXX f(); meaning that the Callable either returns a Result<XXX, E> or a XXX directly, where XXX can be any type that is suitable for use by class Result. The return type of this function is decltype(f()) for a template argument F that returns a Result type, and it is Result<decltype(f()), E> for a template argument F that does not return a Result type. If this instance does not contain a value, a new Result<XXX, E> is still created and returned, with the original error contents of this instance being copied into the new instance Header-Datei #include "ara/core/result.h" class mono Scope class ara::core::Result < void, E > class mono Exception-Sicherheit not exception safe class mono Thread-Sicherheit conditional, depends on thread safety of f class mono Template-Parameter th Parameter th Beschreibung td F td the type of the Callable f Parameter (in) th Parameter th Beschreibung td f td the Callable Rückgabewert th Typ th Beschreibung td <see below> td a new Result instance of the possibly transformed type
